review_description: Once we watched Finn Peacock on YouTube we were well placed to request quotes based on recommended products.  After that getting quotes was easier and we could request these based on a comparison of apples to apples.We went with 4Shore and it was a seamless experience.Queensland Commercial Solar were in second place only beaten by price. They were very good and easy to deal with.

Was all hassle free from initial sales inquiry to the completed install.  We got a few quotes and one did not leave ANY paperwork to evaluate once salesperson had left - 4shore were the opposite with brochures and facts and figures.  Grant answered all our questions.  Then as we took our time in making decision they did not "hound" us.  Once we made our decision the system was installed within  a couple of weeks.The installation was not straight forward as there was one specific requirement that was not negotiable.  This was discussed with installation supervisor who met the request, then the rest of he install went ahead without problem.4shore Solar was not the cheapest but we chose to run with them as the reviews on the cheaper system suppliers were not favorable, particularly with regard to deliver (Install) delays.

I highly recommend any one planning to have solar installed to 4 Shore as they are the best, honest and their quality product. They came promptly to reprogram the Wifi system when I had joined the TPG NBN.
Jason and his team were excellent; Their work was clean and efficient and advice given courteously. Communication and co-ordination through the office worked very well.
Good friendly professional service. Very happy.
